Royal Flux — The Astral Shadow Plague

name: Royal Flux: The Astral Shadow Plague
summary:
A card system built for thinkers

Royal Flux is a turn-based card battle game where both sides place simultaneously — you never know exactly what your opponent is committing until combat resolves. Victory belongs to the player who reads the board, builds the better deck, and understands the kingdom triangle before the damage is done.

This is not a game of whoever draws the rarest card. There are no packs to purchase, no randomised loot, and no pay-to-win shortcuts. Every card in Royal Flux earns its place through strategic composition and the mechanics that govern how kingdoms clash.
